text:
maya: Found a mystery bag of pastries in the kitchen. Who claims? :eyes:
ton y: Not mine. Could be pastry saboteur. :baguette_bread:
alice: I actually brought a few things this morning — not the mystery bag, but feel free to help yourselves. Label the box please? :grimacing:
sam: Whoever took the blue-sticker muffin owes me a coffee. :coffee: @alice?
alice: lol not me, went gluten-free this week, so 0 muffins consumed here. :v:
jen: Quick poll — muffins vs croissants? React with 🧁 or 🥐 (also, I nominate this thread for "one-liner lottery")
devops-bot: Reminder: fridge cleanout scheduled Friday 3pm. Please tag items with `@expiry: YYYY-MM-DD` if you want to keep them.
maya: Also shoutout to @tony for rescuing the office ficus from the draft yesterday :star2:
tony: thank you! I will accept temporary watering duties for 3 more weeks. Plant and pastries both secured. :seedling:
sam: One-liner: "I came for the pastries, stayed for the potted-plant diplomacy." :joy:
jen: vote recorded. Sam wins the one-liner lottery by unanimous emoji. :trophy: :confetti_ball:
alice: Also, proposed new label for the stash: `Free Snacks — First Come, Please Refill` (optional, but adorable)
maya: agreed. If anyone wants to volunteer as Snack Custodian for a week, reply here. :raised_hands:
